settings.label: Enabled
settings.description:
Browses what Prime Video carries, and plays it in Prime Video's own player full screen
Needs Chromium with Widevine (on the OSD/OS image already)

settings.label: Sign In
settings.description:
Opens Prime Video's sign-in page full screen, to sign in with a keyboard
This player stays signed in until Sign Out

settings.label: TMDB Key
settings.description:
The key the catalog is read with: free from themoviedb.org, Settings, API
One key serves Netflix and Prime Video alike

settings.label: Catalog Region
settings.description:
The country whose Prime Video catalog to list, the time zone's until one is chosen (else the USA)
Titles come from TMDB, which needs a free API key: TMDB Key, above
This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB
Streaming data from JustWatch

settings.label: Catalog Language
settings.description: The language of titles and genres in the catalog

settings.label: Scaling
settings.description:
How a 16:9 picture fills the 4:3 screen in this module
[DEFAULT] As Settings' Scaling says

settings.label: Sign Out
settings.description:
Forgets the Prime Video sign-in on this player
The next visit asks for it again
